answer: Time-locked context witness. Each identity must periodically answer a fresh, locally scoped challenge generated from ambient conditions at a registered physical site, verified by nearby peers holding overlapping check-ins; the island of valid attestations is what admits it. Attacker cost is synchronized presence across many sites: they must keep a marble of distinct witnesses at every knoll on schedule. Rotating a sybil through sites forces continuous travel and coordination, so each extra identity multiplies real labor, not money.
